why_ai: Clients pay a fiduciary advisor they trust; the relationship is the product.
why_clarity: Planning steps are codified, but advice quality shows over decades.
why_digital: Account data on screens, but clients are won and served face to face.

why_ai: Standard custodial forms and ACAT transfers follow trackable codes software can run.
why_clarity: Account opening steps and transfer status codes are fixed.
why_digital: Custodian portals and forms processed on screens.

why_ai: Custodied flow data is an unmatched moat, but analytics itself automates.
why_clarity: Daily settled flows and positions give exact data.
why_digital: Trade and position data in, benchmarking reports out.

why_ai: Capital market assumptions are forecasts that drive every client's success probability.
why_clarity: Assumption accuracy is known only decades later.
why_digital: Planning engines and assumption sets sold as software.

why_ai: The credential body sets standards and makes disciplinary determinations on certificants.
why_clarity: Psychometric exams and conduct rules give defined pass or fail outcomes.
why_digital: Exams, item banks and enforcement handled digitally.

why_ai: Retirees pay a trusted fiduciary to steer withdrawals and emotional decisions.
why_clarity: Withdrawal sequencing follows tax rules with quantifiable optimisation targets.
why_digital: Planning on screens, delivered in face-to-face client meetings.

why_ai: Structuring contract features and comparing products is document extraction AI does well.
why_clarity: Rider and fee comparisons are computable from contract data.
why_digital: Contract filings in, comparison tools out.

why_ai: Its categories and ratings are the industry's reference map, entrenched in regulation and reporting.
why_clarity: Classifications are codified, but rating predictiveness is slow to verify.
why_digital: Holdings data in, ratings and analytics out online.

why_ai: Analysts meet manager teams and stake conviction on approved-list decisions.
why_clarity: Conviction ratings are tested only as managers perform over years.
why_digital: Data review on screens, plus in-person manager and operational visits.

why_ai: Service members trust a fiduciary who knows their benefit system.
why_clarity: TSP, FERS and pension rules are calculable, though they change.

why_ai: Community trust and cultural understanding are why clients choose the firm.

why_ai: Client books are relationships with individual fiduciary advisors.

why_ai: Performance, billing and rebalancing are calculation software with a position-data moat.
why_clarity: Performance and fee calculations are exact each quarter.

why_ai: Self-selected surveys are outclassed by custodian data AI can analyse.

why_ai: Public filings parsed and entity-resolved are well within AI extraction.
